answer: The protocol enforces capacity-reservations by requiring each AI agent to reserve 1,000 credits for a dedicated jetty of service capacity, securing an exclusive path for its own unique data stream. Fraud triggers a 180-day lock on all collateral until full restitution concludes to maintain stability.
